facts.fact: Law No. 2024/017 of 23 December 2024 on personal data protection was enacted by the President of the Republic, and Section 73 gives controllers 18 months from enactment to comply.
facts.system: Law No. 2024/017 relating to personal data protection in Cameroon

facts.fact: Section 53 makes the Personal Data Protection Authority an independent public body and leaves its establishment, organisation and functioning to a decree of the President; the text records no appointment.
